description: View and edit detailed contact information including personal details, professional information, communication preferences, and associated documents. Central place for managing all aspects of an individual contact person.

pages.name: ContactViewComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing and managing all aspects of a specific contact. It allows users to access and modify personal details, professional information, communication preferences, and associated documents. From here, you can get a complete overview of an individual contact.

help_guidance.when_stuck: This page displays comprehensive contact information. To make changes, click the 'Edit' button. You can upload a new contact photo by clicking on the current photo or avatar area. Scroll down to find sections for associated documents and links. All contact fields are logically grouped by category for easy navigation and access.
common_tasks: Editing contact info: Click the 'Edit' button, then modify the desired fields in the form that appears. Remember to save your changes.
Uploading photo: Click on the contact's current photo or the placeholder avatar. A dialog will appear, allowing you to select and upload a new image for the contact.
Viewing interactions: Navigate to the 'Interactions' tab (if available) to review the communication history and past engagements with this contact.
Managing documents: Scroll down to the 'Documents' section. Here you can upload new files related to the contact or view and download existing ones.
Updating contact details: Locate the specific section (e.g., Personal, Professional, Address) and use the 'Edit' function to update information such as name, title, company, or physical address.
Managing links: Find the 'Links' section to add new external references or modify existing ones that are relevant to the contact.
